item.title: 20 years ago today: J Dilla released his classic album <i>Donuts</i>
item.description: On this day 20 years ago, J Dilla released his instrumental hip-hop masterpiece, <i>Donuts</i> – just three days before his death, aged 32. To mark the album's anniversary, we're revisiting some special reflections from the <i>Hot Press</i> archives.

item.title: Ireland’s fastest man Israel Olatunde: "I had quiet confidence and said, 'This is going to happen to me eventually'"
item.description: After breaking his own records in 2025, Ireland’s fastest man, Israel Olatunde, talks training with the world’s best coaches, Irish athletic camaraderie, and his goals for 2026.

item.title: Live Report: ‘History at The Making - The Concert’ at the 3Arena – Van Morrison, Imelda May and more kick off Hot Press’s 50th anniversary celebrations
item.description: Irish music legends and innovative new stars unite at Dublin’s 3Arena for one extraordinary night of music, poetry, comedy and more.

item.title: Rob Doyle on <i>Cameo:</i> "I felt like I had turned fiction inside out, in a way"
item.description: Rob Doyle discusses his meta extravaganza <i>Cameo,</i> the cultural ructions of the past decade, and the memorable screen adaptation of his novel <i>Here Are The Young Men,</i> starring Anya Taylor-Joy.

item.title: Hot Flavours: Mowgli Street Food, Cantina Valentina, Polonez, Slane Whiskey, Active Brewing and more
item.description: Peruvian Ceviche, Mexican Chamoy, Golumpki Cabbage Soup and Treacle Tamarind Fries are all on the menu, as Stuart Clark brings you 2026’s tastiest food trends.
